What is our profit margin by genre?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT g.Name as Genre,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity),0),2) as Revenue,
       COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) as InvoiceLineCount,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity),0) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity),0) FROM InvoiceLine),2) as RevenuePct
FROM Genre g
LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;"}
